pages.lines:
Enjoy scenic South Dakota camping at our resort in the Black Hills. You will find our resort to be clean, quiet, well shaded and scenic. Our staff continuously strives to offer a well-maintained and modern facility while not losing sight of the rustic setting which makes us unique. The Rafter J Bar Ranch is comprised of six camping areas separated by alpine meadows and shaded by large ponderosa pines. Choose a remote site, or camp close to the resorts activity center. We offer electric, water, and sewer sites, limited tent sites, and cabins. Enjoy a crackling fire and quiet hours that begin at 10:00 P.M. There’s also full-time camp security.
*Request a specific site for only a one time $20 fee!
Office and Store hours 7:00am-7:00pm
+10
We found this campground by accident but firmly believe it is the best campground we've stayed. Everything is well maintained and the sites are plentiful and spacious. We stayed in the Ranch area and had super large site just steps away from a great bathhouse. And to top it off, they have a fantastic pancake breakfast for $5. We cannot wait to get back!
